document.abstract: With the adoption of high definition (HD) and its commensurate requirement for increased storage capacity and bandwidth, the need for scalability has increased. Because of its deterministic performance and dual-ported redundancy, Fiber Channel is the leading technology for storage connection and storage area network (SAN) development (see Annex 2 SAN Storage Interfaces). By applying the latest advances in Fiber Channel technology, larger, more capable, and more redundant systems can be built to meet this need.
